How it works
one coin, round the machine, forever

What does one request cost the garbage collector?

Every exchange runs one coin round the machine. The reading bridge is Glyph11: headers become zero-copy ByteString views over the request buffer — no strings minted. The gate is the handler tree, the press is serialization, and the return chute empties back into the pool.
